app_description.message: Capture the full page, the visible part, or a selected area. Save as PNG, JPG, or PDF, copy, or print. Free and open source.

popup_capture_full_hint.message: Scrolls through the whole page and stitches it

popup_capture_visible_hint.message: Only what you see right now

popup_capture_selection_hint.message: Drag a rectangle on the page

popup_busy.message: A capture is already in progress.

popup_error_unsupported.message: This page cannot be captured. Browser pages, the extension store, and some protected pages are blocked by the browser.

selection_hint.message: Drag to select an area. Press Esc to cancel.

viewer_not_found.message: This capture is no longer available.

viewer_error_copy.message: Could not copy the image to the clipboard.

viewer_trimmed.message: The page was taller than the maximum image size, so the capture was trimmed to $HEIGHT$ px.

history_empty.message: No captures yet. Take a screenshot and it will show up here.

history_confirm_clear.message: Delete all captures from the history? This cannot be undone.

history_retention_note.message: Captures are kept for $DAYS$ days. Change this in Options.

history_retention_forever.message: Captures are kept until you delete them.

options_save_as_dialog.message: Ask where to save each file

options_hide_fixed.message: Hide fixed headers and sticky bars after the first screen (avoids repeated bars in full-page captures)

options_capture_delay_hint.message: Gives you time to open menus or hover elements.

options_shortcuts_hint.message: Shortcuts are managed by the browser.

error_capture_failed.message: The capture could not be completed.
